The test image shows a cluster of collapsed, dead/dying soybean plants with bleached/tan stems in the center of a field, while surrounding plants remain healthy and green. This clumped stand collapse pattern is distinctive.

The White Mold reference collage (top-right panel) shows an almost identical field view — collapsed plants with bleached stems amid healthy green plants. White Mold (Sclerotinia) causes girdling of stems at nodes, plant wilting and death, bleached dead stems, and this characteristic clumped field pattern.
